name: Spectre: NINE EYES — Special-Agent Mission Software
description: BOND film package for Spectre (2015), mission codename NINE EYES. Six pure, deterministic analysis modules: surveillance-network data-flow centralization and betweenness; criminal-organisation cell structure and compartmentalization; connectivity geometry, articulation points and critical nodes; volume-weighted traffic interception and budgeted monitoring; compromise cascades through the brotherhood; and sensor-placement set cover with coverage redundancy. Deterministic, zero-mock, protocol-driven.
